# Itchy Palms Landscapes

## About
Itchy Palms Landscapes is Toowoomba's no-nonsense, high-quality lawn and garden service, founded by Matt. Since 2024, the team has built a strong reputation in Toowoomba by ensuring all work meets the highest standard, using top-of-the-line equipment to deliver the cleanest cuts, sharpest edges, and neatest finishes. The business holds QBCC Licence 15551711 and is Blue Card certified.

## Services
Lawn Care & Maintenance
Turf Installation
Irrigation Systems
Garden & Landscape Maintenance
Landscaping & Construction
Structural Landscaping
Specialised & Add-On Services

## Service Areas
